It was constructed as a 5 room cottage to house executives visiting the nearby tannery.  This was the last stop of the Knoxville and Augusta line of the Southern Railway System, and the starting point for the Little River Railroad.  The Inn was named by Mrs. Rachel Fisher, wife of the builder, Mr. A. J. Fisher who was also superintendent of the tannery.
Little River Railroad (Tennessee) | The Little River Railroad is a historic class III railroad that operated between Maryville and Elkmont, Tennessee during the period 1901 to 1939.

Today, Elkmont is home to a large campground, ranger station, and historic district maintained by the Great Smoky Mountains National Park.
Augusta and Knoxville Railroad | The Augusta and Knoxville Railroad was chartered in 1877 and opened a line in 1882, stretching 66 mi between Augusta, Georgia, and Greenwood, South Carolina. In 1894, the ETV&G merged with the Richmond and Danville Railroad to form the Southern Railway.

The line is operated by Norfolk Southern (NS) as part of the railway's Piedmont Division.  The R-Line originally operated by the former Charlotte, Columbia and Augusta Railroad before being merged in 1878 with the Richmond and Danville which merged with the Southern in 1894.  Today it was now operated by NS.
Knoxville and Holston River Railroad | The Knoxville and Holston River Railroad (reporting mark KXHR) operates over 18.98 mi within Knoxville and Marbledale, Tennessee.  This short line railroad was created in 1998 and is currently owned by Gulf and Ohio Railways.  The railroad also hosts a tourist train run by Gulf & Ohio Railways, the "Three Rivers Rambler".

Tennessee Civil War National Heritage Area | Tennessee Civil War National Heritage Area is a federally designated National Heritage Area that encompasses the entire U.S. state of Tennessee. Maryville High School (Tennessee) | Maryville High School ("'MHS") is currently a three-year public high school with grades 10-12.  It was founded in 1918 in Maryville, Tennessee and is a part of the Maryville City Schools system.
Norfolk Southern Tennessee River Bridge | The Norfolk Southern Tennessee River Bridge is a lift bridge operated by the Norfolk Southern Railway over the Tennessee River at Decatur in the north central part of Alabama in the United States. Maryville, Tennessee | Maryville is a city and the county seat of Blount County, Tennessee, in the southeastern United States.  Maryville's population was 27,465 at the 2010 census.  It is included in the Knoxville Metropolitan Area.
Little Pigeon River (Tennessee) | The Little Pigeon River is a river located entirely within Sevier County, Tennessee.  It rises from a series of streams which flow together on the dividing ridge between the states of Tennessee and North Carolina inside the boundary of the Great Smoky Mountains National Park.  The river is subdivided with three separate tributaries: East, Middle, and West.
